title: [Podetry] Pour Hot Water Into a Pot With Leaves
author: Literarion
fandoms: Good Omens - Neil Gaiman & Terry Pratchett
tags: making tea is literally so easy but not when you're distracted
forgetting how to do simple things because you're in lust
summary: A poem about that thing where you're so enamoured with someone that you suddenly can't function properly. You're uncharacteristically clumsy and you can't seem to remember what the next step is to something so simple that you've done a thousand times before; like making tea. Because how can you be expected to be normal when the object of your desire is sitting RIGHT THERE? Like THAT? Aziraphale struggles this way at times.

title: The Road Not Taken
author: Lumisse
fandoms: Good Omens - Neil Gaiman & Terry Pratchett
tags: Other Additional Tags to Be Added
summary:
“Please,” Aziraphale choked out, his voice barely audible, “Please, don’t ask me to stay.”
Crowley let out a soft, shuddering breath. He squeezed Aziraphale’s hand tighter, his fingers wrapping securely around his. When Aziraphale opened his eyes, Crowley was looking at him with a tenderness so profound it made Aziraphale's heart ache.
“Aziraphale,” Crowley said softly, “I would never do that.”
Aziraphale comes back to his small hometown years later and runs into the first love he left behind, only to realise those feelings never really left.

title: Cottage Chaos
author: belovedhypnos
fandoms: Good Omens - Neil Gaiman & Terry Pratchett
characters: Original Child(ren) of Aziraphale and Crowley (Good Omens)
summary: It had taken a solid month of heavy coaxing to get Aziraphale out of the house. “You deserve a break, angel”, Crowley had insisted, gazing down at his very exhausted partner who was slumped back against the sofa cushions, Zephyr latched on to his breast, nursing with a fierce appetite. “You’ve seemed kinda… depleted lately. Go get rubbed down with lavender oil or whatever it is you do. I’ve got everything under control.”After a few more words of reassurance and permission to drive the Bentley—under the strict condition that it remain black—Aziraphale had finally agreed to go to London for a bit of a spa day.He had been gone for two and a half hours, and Crowley did not have everything under control.*In short: Crowley is left alone with the kids, and chaos ensues.
